projectDescription: A .NET 10 background service that watches Cloudflare WAF analytics, auto-blocks offending IPs on a Cloudflare account-level IP list, and manages TTL-based expiry using a local SQLite store.
keyFeatures: Automatic IP blocking triggered by Cloudflare WAF rule hits
HTTP status code anomaly detection (400, 404, 403, 500, etc.) per IP
Distributed path detection to identify coordinated scanning across multiple IPs
TTL-based expiry — blocks are automatically removed from Cloudflare after a configurable duration
SQLite-backed local state store for block persistence and TTL tracking
Configurable polling interval, jitter, and analysis window
Loopback/localhost exclusion from HTTP status auto-blocking
Docker and Docker Compose deployment with environment-variable configuration
publicApiSurface: GET /status — returns running state, startedAt, lastSuccessfulPollAt, lastCleanupAt
WafAutoblockOptions — root configuration class (Cloudflare, Polling, Storage, Rules, HttpStatusDetection)
RuleMonitorOptions — Name, RuleId, Threshold, TtlMinutes, Enabled
HttpStatusCodeRuleOptions — StatusCode, Enabled, MinTotalErrors, MinDistinctPaths, MinCodeRatio, TtlMinutes, Name
DistributedPathDetectionOptions — Enabled, StatusCodes[], MinPathTotalErrors, MinDistinctIpsPerPath, MinIpHitsOnSuspiciousPaths, MinDistinctSuspiciousPathsPerIp, TtlMinutes, Name, ExcludedPaths[]
